flagship_directive: Construct a law-independent distance-based estimator attaining outer-expected uniform risk O((log n/n)^(1/4)) over the full published P_NP(L,q) class, thereby converting the resolved logarithmic converse into a same-class minimax characterization.
critique: The full P_NP result proves only the necessity of the logarithmic penalty for distance-compressed decision rules; it provides no matching achievability or full minimax characterization. The matched result is instead confined to the separately constructed P12 class, with Euclidean distance, the uniform kernel, rectangular support, uniform Gram and local-mass conditions, moment envelopes, and the additional restriction L >= L0(p), so it does not settle the frontier over CTY's broader published regime. This scope gap prevents the two results from combining into a full-P_NP matched theorem and keeps the contribution below flagship level. No stale overclaim appears: the TL;DR, project justification, and scope sections consistently distinguish the converse-only P_NP theorem from the matched P12 theorem.
